definitions.usage: dwarf, lean(-fleshed), very little thing, small, thin.
definitions.full: H1851. daq דַּק adjective thin, small, fine — absolute masculine ׳דּ Exod 16:14 4 t.; דָּ֑ק Lev 13:30 ; feminine דַּקָּה 16:12 ; 1Kin 19:12 ; plural feminine absolute דַּקּוֺת Gen 41:6 2 t.; דַּקֹּת 41:24 ; construct דַּקּוֺת 41:3 , דַּקֹּת 41:4 ; — 1 thin , of kine ׳דּ בָּשָׂר Gen 41:3 compare 41:4 ( ⅏ has in both רַקּוֺת compare ᵑ0 41:19 ; 41:20 ; 41:27 ); of ears of corn 41:6 ; 41:7 ; 41:23 ; 41:24 (all E); thin, shrunk, withered , of man Lev 21:20 (H). 2 small, fine , of the manna כַּכְּפֹר דַּק מְחֻסְמָּס דַּק Exod 16:14 ; of incense Lev 16:12 , hair 13:30 (all P); of dust דַּק אָבָק Isa 29:5 ; in simile of isles in hand of יִטּוֺל כַּדַּק אִיִּים ׳י, 40:15 ( דַּק = substantive fine thing, fine dust ); once of a low whisper דַקָּה דְּמָמָה קוֺל 1Kin 19:12 .
